title: Picnic
hook: 一家人去野餐，鸭子们闻着味就来了，最后连蛋糕都被抢走了。

cells.a: It was a lovely, bright and sunny day.
cells.cn: 那天阳光明亮，天气很好。

cells.a: He said, “This looks like just the spot for our picnic!”
cells.cn: 他说：“这地方正适合野餐！”

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig not want to do?
cells.a: He did not want to run around at all.
cells.cn: 他一点也不想跑来跑去。

cells.a: She asked, “Mummy, can we feed the ducks?”
cells.cn: 她问：“妈妈，我们能喂鸭子吗？”

cells.a: They wanted more food from the children.
cells.cn: 鸭子们还想吃，一直要更多。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say about the cake?
cells.a: She said, “If there's any cake left, give it to the ducks.”
cells.cn: 她说剩下的蛋糕可以给鸭子。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig tell Peppa?
cells.a: He said, “All you have to do is stay still!”
cells.cn: 他说：“你只要站着不动就行！”

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say to Daddy?
cells.a: She said, “But I didn't believe you'd do it!”
cells.cn: 她说：“我都没料到你真会这么做！”

cells.q: What did the family say about the ducks?
cells.a: They said, “You are very lucky ducks.”
cells.cn: 他们说：“你们真是幸运的鸭子。”

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Picnic”.
ending: In the end, the ducks get the last piece of cake. My favourite part is ______.
